architecture_summary: Project Detection -> BLUE_BAND_GLYPH_QUAD_V1 -> Project Recognition -> structural validation -> human review
intended_use: Controlled Turkish license-plate detection and recognition research with explicit human review.
limitations: No independent field-holdout evidence or production-accuracy claim.
Predictions require human review and must not be treated as verified identity records.
Private model weights are not distributed.
project_provenance: Project-developed PyTorch implementations, configurations, training, evaluation, and integration.

citations.reference: Ge et al., YOLOX: Exceeding YOLO Series in 2021, arXiv:2107.08430
